notes.subject: feat(browser-gateway): add files, photos and camera buttons to mobile Ask Agent composer
notes.summary: Mobile and touch Ask Agent composers in the browser gateway gain Files, Photos and Camera buttons to attach images, PDFs and text files from the device.

notes.subject: fix(browser-gateway): keep saved model and thinking level across catalog reloads
notes.summary: Desktop and Browser Ask Agent keep the saved model and thinking level when provider catalogs load or reconnect, instead of overwriting them with a temporary fallback.

notes.subject: fix(guardian): keep the Jev first-pass Guardian audit running
notes.summary: The first-pass Guardian audit now keeps running after a command starts instead of being cancelled and recorded as a deny; telemetry reports unfinished audits separately.

dd819f3c9d12f09b8af7b97544b2e43bd5f118a2.summary: When Guardian denies an MCP tool call in Approve for Me sessions, the call now pauses for a human approval card showing the reason and arguments instead of failing immediately; hard restrictions still apply.

870bdc1a3b83d150e754d4c1888e6e5d9190d6a1.summary: Requires direct approval for broad pkill/killall patterns, makes regex find_and_replace interpret \n, \t and \\ like VS Code, and connects the Browser Ask Agent MCP hub lazily to avoid duplicate stdio MCP servers.

ddcc086e12f0e116168d13964f92684cd6c0bb60.summary: When Codex web_fetch pagination stalls before serving all lines, the warning now states the page is incomplete, names the missing line range, and suggests another web transport.

626c75fb4b3c87cef97840c3a12a8f82383bca23.summary: The optional TypeSafe Guardian shadow evaluation now defaults to the pinned jev-1.14.0 model and sends secret-redacted script bodies and environment facts with reworded questions; shadow results still never affect approvals.}]}</br>

911aa1059aa2819e76a76519e1170e025f7f326b.summary: TypeSafe Guardian shadow mode now keeps up to 8 recorded human answers, redacting per field and shortening only long agent-written context, and session telemetry reports per-cohort results.}]}</br>

df2457ce6f5c08620c26039a5756be435961229d.summary: The optional TypeSafe Guardian shadow reviewer now receives git branch and remote facts and no longer treats omitted older answers as missing evidence for read-only or local toolchain commands, with a new telemetry field recording waivers.

d78e5b6eb34c5bf8e82d60b7568957f9dc388252.summary: Adds local developer tooling to replay hand-labelled commands through the Jev shadow reviewer, and exports two helper functions internally; no user-facing feature or behaviour change in the shipped products.

5accef8e78f9930bb3c5260a1a13223c624ea732.summary: Adds an opt-in, off-by-default TypeSafe Jev first pass that can approve confident, low-risk commands before the Guardian finishes (with a background audit), plus new settings, telemetry and a wider older-decision waiver for local git steps.

50fbc610a6459c3b39cb6dcbc1efa1353940f6a7.summary: Approve for Me now reviews unapproved MCP tool calls and unseen public network destinations with Guardian, optionally letting TypeSafe Jev allow confident cases first, with human fallback for risky, denied or unavailable reviews.
